prompt:
Image 1 is only a palette and art-style reference (Hiro, a humble boy traveler with a wooden sword, brown cloth and a green scarf). Do NOT draw the character or the sword.

Create a 6-frame LOOPING spell VFX sprite sheet: a modest swirl of DUST and a little wind rising around the feet of a boy who plants his feet to focus (the boy is NOT drawn; the middle stays empty magenta). Low ground-level dust curls and a few small pebbles and leaves lifting, reaching only to knee height, at the bottom of the cell.
PLAIN and MODEST: this is the free starter hero, so the effect is simple and down to earth. Painted as OPAQUE solid shapes with crisp edges: no glow halo, no haze, no sparkles, no gold light, no jewels, no rainbow colours, no magic runes. No pink, no purple, no magenta tint. Colours only pale beige, sandy brown, light grey and a touch of dull green.
Exactly 6 frames in a 3 columns x 2 rows grid of equal square 512x512 cells, total image 1536x1024, read left-to-right then next row. Nothing crosses a cell edge; leave a magenta margin of at least 8% on all sides of every cell. Background 100% solid flat #FF00FF magenta in every cell, no gradient, no text, no labels, no borders, no gridlines. Clean HD smooth painted anime game VFX, NOT pixel art.

precheck.summary: The candidate matches the prompt: six dust-and-leaf swirl frames in a 3x2 grid on a flat magenta background, with no character, text, or border. The effects stay within their cells and sit near the bottom, and the palette is beige, sandy brown, grey and a touch of green. The only minor note is a faint reddish streak under some dust clouds, which is not a clear defect.
